_comment: Budget input for `attribution.ts --budgets`. It declares the four legs the
spec requires and the number of consecutive green CI runs collected for
each. Phase 1's merge has not happened, so every leg stands at zero and the
gate refuses to derive a budget. Phase 9 fills `perLegFamilySummed` from the
stored JUnit artifacts and raises `runsPerLeg` to 3; nothing else changes.
Local timing lives in `attribution.md` and is never a budget input — a
`kind` of `local` is refused before any leg is read.
